normative_extracts.quote: Scroll snap positions are offsets within the scroll container’s scrollable overflow area where scrolling is encouraged or required to come to rest.

engine_internals.mechanism_summary: Layout collects child snap rects; the Compositor Thread predicts fling velocity and lands cleanly on the nearest snap point.

production_failures.symptom: Users cannot scroll past tall content inside a mandatory scroll-snap section
production_failures.root_cause: scroll-snap-type: y mandatory forces the viewport to snap back to the section’s single alignment edge.
production_failures.mitigation: Use scroll-snap-type: y proximity for variable-height sections, reserving mandatory for uniform carousels.

production_failures.symptom: Anchor links (#section-2) land tucked underneath a sticky header
production_failures.root_cause: Scroll container lacks scroll-padding-top matching the sticky header height.
production_failures.mitigation: Set scroll-padding-top: 4rem on the scroll container (works for both #anchor jumps and scroll-snap).
